messages:
maria_dev: heads-up — customer demo next Tue, we need a short H100 burst (4 nodes) for ~2h. who can confirm availability and an estimated rate?
vendor_ops: we can tentatively hold 4xH100 in us-west1 for a 2h window. rate card v3 shows $120/hr per node. will need PO# to lock.
kevin_infra: quick quota check — current reserved H100s in us-west1 = 2. we can carve 2 more but need finance sign-off to hit provider reservation limit. fallback plan = 2 H100 + 2 A100.
kevin_infra: snapshot command I ran: ```gcloud compute reservations list --filter="name~'rw-demo'" --project=redwood-infer``` shows existing reservations.
maria_dev: elena_finance can you fast-track a PO? demo is external and high priority (sales-led).
elena_finance: I can approve up to $1k for this demo now. need vendor pro-forma invoice with line items + dates. cc @kevin_infra.
kevin_infra: I'll open a temporary quota request with cloud and tag it for expedited review. if quota denied, plan to deploy mixed pool via terraform: ```terraform apply -var='reserve_h100=2' -var='reserve_a100=2'``` and run reduced batch-size for the demo.
sam_ops: +1 on mixed pool fallback. I can run a smoke test tonight to confirm latency degrade is acceptable. schedule me once reserve is in place. :thumbsup:
vendor_ops: sending pro-forma now, holding tentative slots until EOD Friday. invoice will include PO field and rate breakdown.
deploy-bot: Reservation request created: #req-4521 (status: pending, owner: kevin_infra)
kevin_infra: opened ticket https://console.cloud/requests/4521 - flagged for expedited handling. will post updates here.
maria_dev: perfect — thanks all. ping me when PO + quota confirmed and I’ll freeze the demo prompts and run the smoke tests.
